scope: Bounded economic corporate-action accounting closeout; no new signals, sources, tuning, execution or UI.
rules: Reuse parent universe, quality, prices, timing, ranking, hysteresis, sector cap and risk target; fractional corporate entitlements permitted, ordinary target orders integer.
inherited_share_policy: Book distributed/exchanged shares as holdings at event session open, dispose only inherited quantity at next equity-session open with same bps fee; do not substitute ranking candidates. Acquisition events mapped from last trade date to following equity session. No immediate sale or spinoffdividend cash credit.
ambiguous_terms: Election-only, missing recipient quote, ambiguous share units, missing settlement/proration/CVR remain unverified; retain flagged legacy last-price proxy for unresolved exits only. No alternatives summed or invented.
acceptance: Net CAGR above QQQ TR proxy and maximum drawdown no worse than -30%, plus all economic/PIT/data gates. Previously inspected history is diagnostic, not holdout.
stop_rule: Complete these accounting stages once, register all attempts; stop current equity alpha development if no credible joint pass. Unresolved gates mean investment evidence insufficient, not automatic scope extension. Reopening requires separately authorized evidence-driven hypothesis.
